preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 500,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the edges must be within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal time t required for all ants to reach the root.
